commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE new square full-bleed 1536x1536 cartoon game illustration, using the two supplied images solely as style and character references. Match their bold dark ink outlines, flat cream/teal/forest green/golden yellow palette, subtle printed halftone and limited cel shading. Same friendly stocky grower with teal cap and overalls, rounded simple face, realistic-sized equipment, calm practical gestures. A small enclosed indoor growing cupboard with opaque reflective liner, upright dark frame and door edges, a normal clip-on fan and tidy extraction duct. NO greenhouse, windows, outdoor scenery, photorealism, 3D, fantasy items, decorative symbols, panels, inset diagram, lettering, numbers or logos. Main incident clearly visible at 300px, closer framing and fewer objects. The crop is agricultural hemp, illustrated botanically in the current growth stage. For drying scenes the cultivation LED is OFF, use soft ambient room light. Return the generated image local path.
